title: Ecology SpeciesAreaIsland

stats.done_summary: Research task completed successfully. Analysis of the species-area relationship using island_species.csv (25 islands) yielded a significant power-law model: S = 14.30 × A^0.22 (R² = 0.22, p = 0.017). The z-value of 0.22 falls within the expected range for island systems. Two figures were generated: (1) species-area relationship with raw data, log-log plot, and residuals; (2) conservation implications showing species accumulation and predicted species loss from habitat reduction. The report discusses implications for conservation planning including reserve design, habitat fragmentation concerns, and extinction debt. All deliverables complete: code/analysis.py, outputs/model_results.csv, report/images/*.png, and report/report.md.
